quoted_sentence: In the zero-shot setting, simply using features from a pre-trained MEG-GPT improved “Within Subject” accuracy from 0.54 (baseline) and 0.56 (baseline+PCA) to 0.59 and, more dramatically, “New Subject” accuracy from 0.41 (baseline) and 0.45 (baseline+PCA) to 0.49.
notes: Values are printed in the text to two decimals; Fig. 8 shows them as bars with 95% CIs over sessions, but the CI values are not printed, so no error bar is plotted for the paper column.
Fig. 8 chance level: 0.25 (red dotted line in the paper figure; four-way classification).
The paper's fine-tuned cell (new subject 0.51) is not part of this figure: the replication did not run it.
